sites.name: HMS Victoria

s2.quote: rising up from 140m to 77m with her bow deeply embedded in the thick layer of sediment … long decompression stops in 18° C (64F) cold water

sites.depthNote: Stands vertically, stern about 77 m, bow in sediment at 140 m

summary.text: A Victorian battleship lost in a 1893 collision, standing upright with its bow buried in sediment off Tripoli. The stern is near 77 m and the wreck falls to about 140 m, so only trimix rebreather divers visit.
